about: PCA J110: QuranRevival built from the MSA source. LIVE from v11.39 (the Owner ticked A, switch, 18 Oct 2026, J110 n110c). QR's own files are in apps/qr/site, its deliberate changes to shared files are counted edits in apps/qr/edits.json, and apps/qr/after-build.mjs fills QR's own offline worker. The QR repository publishes the build with .github/workflows/build-from-msa.yml once its Pages source is GitHub Actions; the way back is QR Settings > Pages > Deploy from a branch.
later: QR's heading: name.short is QuranRevival, so the heading reads QuranRevival at every width, as QR does today (QR's edits #11a-#11c are not used: the title and heading come from these settings, and the version is MSA's one number, QR J22)

pages: the built QR holds only today's QR's 6 pages; any other page address gives QR's 404, and qr-links.js sends links to those pages to MSA, as today. hiddenModules stays as MSA's until nav.js tags every module
step 2: name.full.bn once the Owner gives QR's Bangla name (today QR shows QuranRevival in Bangla too)

step 3 (built): the built QR keeps QR's own worker (apps/qr/site/app/sw.js, its proven upgrade path); apps/qr/after-build.mjs fills its version (MSA's number) and shell from the built app. It names its caches qr-app-<version> and deletes older qr-app-* on activate, and keeps qr-quran-v1. From status live it refuses a version below minVersion 11.39 (frozen QR is 11.38: a phone already running 11.38 would refuse a worker of that number). Later: one worker shared with MSA
step 2: MSA's 'Legacy App - v10' nav link is not in today's QR (PCA J109 decides)

step 3: Hadith data is read from MSA's address (edits ayah-hadith, hadith-translations, openiti-corpus); hadeethenc-corpus.js still reads ../tools/hadith-data-pull: check in step 4 whether a QR page uses it
